content.title: IPL 2026: PBKS vs SRH, Match 17: Stats Review of player records and achieved milestones
content.text: The Punjab Kings (PBKS) secured a six-wicket victory over the Sunrisers Hyderabad (SRH) in Match No. 17 of the Indian Premier League (IPL) 2026 on April 11 at the Maharaja Yadavindra Singh International Cricket Stadium in New Chandigarh.Batting first, SRH posted a formidable 219/6 in their 20 overs, powered by a sensational 74 off 28 balls from Abhishek Sharma, which included five fours and eight sixes. Despite the strong total, PBKS bowlers pulled things back effectively, with Arshdeep Singh and Shashank Singh picking up two wickets each.In reply, PBKS delivered a dominant batting performance to chase down the target with seven balls to spare. The innings was built on a blazing start from Priyansh Arya (57 off 20) and Prabhsimran Singh (51 off 25), who added a quickfire opening stand. Skipper Shreyas Iyer then anchored the chase with a composed unbeaten 69 off 33 balls, ensuring there were no late hiccups.For SRH, Shivang Kumar was the standout performer with the ball, claiming three wickets with his spin.With this win, PBKS remained to second place on the points table with seven points, while SRH slipped to sixth with just two points, marking their third loss of the season.Here are the most important stats from PBKS vs SRH, Match 17: Abhishek Sharma completed 500 fours in T20s Ishan Kishan reached 300 fours in IPL Punjab Kings successfully chased a 200+ target for the 10th time in IPL history PBKS’ 220 chase vs Sunrisers Hyderabad is their second-highest successful run chase in IPL Shivang Kumar became the third SRH spinner to dismiss the opposition’s top three batters in an IPL match 198/0 is the second-highest aggregate score in overs 1-6 (powerplay) in IPL history 16 sixes hit in overs 1-6 is the most ever in an IPL match Priyansh Arya reached his fifty in just 16 balls, the second-fastest for PBKS in IPL PBKS scored 18 runs in the first over, their highest-ever first-over total in IPL
